_comment: Verified Omnibus deployments. 'omnibusAddress' is the canonical CREATE3 address derived from (CreateX, deployer EOA, salt) — predicted by `make verify-omnibus`; 'chains' lists chain ids where it is VERIFIED-deployed. While 'chains' is empty, the SDK resolves no built-in address and requires an override. 'chains' was emptied when the wallet commit route replaced the attested route (two-argument constructor, changed CommitAuth ABI): the address below holds the PRE-wallet-route Omnibus, which this SDK can no longer talk to. Re-verify and re-enable chains only after the wallet-route Omnibus is redeployed (with a bumped salt entropy, hence a NEW address).
